waivers.verdict: Bid $9 on Ollie Gordon as a bench stash, only if neither pending RB trade lands first. Hold Dicker and the Giants — both play this week.

lineup.verdict: Hold the lineup as set. Jaylen Warren (Questionable, shoulder) is the one name to watch before Sunday, but nothing changes it yet.

trades.verdict: Send Kirk Cousins to ObiWanless (roster 6) for RJ Harvey first — their SUPER_FLEX has been sitting empty. Keep last week's Bryce Young-for-Brian Robinson offer to amandaberry alive, but only follow through on it if the Harvey deal falls through.

inactives.verdict: Hold your lineup — nobody is ruled out. Jaylen Warren's questionable tag isn't costing him the start.

actions.name: Ollie Gordon

evidence.note: Achane tore his ACL in Week 3, out for the season; Wright is listed ahead of Gordon on Miami's depth chart but missed Week 3 (foot) and his Week 4 status is unresolved.

actions.why: Achane's season is over and someone in Miami's backfield is about to see a huge workload; Gordon still has to beat out Wright for it, so this is a stash, not a starting swap.

actions.message: Your SUPER_FLEX has been empty behind Burrow — Cousins is a plug-and-play veteran starter there. I'll take RJ Harvey off your bench in return; you're set at RB with Barkley and Walker anyway.

evidence.note: Harvey played 51% of Denver's snaps in the opener as the pass-catching back in a crowded room (Dobbins, Coleman); real role, just not the lead ball-carrier.

actions.why: They've punted a scoring slot every week; Cousins fills it outright. Harvey adds a real body to my 3-deep RB room, which has zero spare right now.

actions.message: Hey — you're starting Lawrence and Love with nobody behind either one, and Bryce Young is Carolina's starter with a Week 5 bye, so he covers both of your quarterbacks' off weeks (Lawrence in 7, Love in 11) instead of just one. Would you do Young for Brian Robinson? You're carrying five backs and he's behind Bijan; I could use a body at running back.

evidence.note: Brian Robinson is a backup behind Bijan Robinson with 22 touches for 98 yards through two games, and was limited with an ankle issue Monday of Week 3.

actions.why: Still unanswered from last Monday. Only complete this if the Harvey deal falls through — doing both leaves just Lamar and Goff at QB, zero backup.
